description: This file contains functions for verifying firmware signatures and images during the upgrade process in OpenWrt, including signature checks, metadata validation, and device compatibility assessments.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Checks the signature of a firmware image, verifying presence and validity of signature files and certificates.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image's metadata and device compatibility for safe upgrade, including version checks and OEM considerations.
